trials.claim: Web Research uses 10 article credits per generated article
trials.claimQuote: Web Research is available for generated articles and uses 10 article credits per generated article.
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence either way about the credit cost of Web Research.

trials.claim: Generate professional AI articles at scale with direct posting to WordPress blog
trials.claimQuote: Generate professional AI articles at scale, and have them posted directly on your Wordpress Blog
trials.reasoning: Buyers report low-quality content not as described and an inability to connect their website to the plugin, materially undercutting professional articles with direct WordPress posting.

exhibits.quote: Refunded immediately after buying due to low-quality content (software not as described).
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the articles were low-quality and not as described, undermining the claim of professional articles.

exhibits.quote: Website won't connect to plugin. I've tried everything in your documentations page and I cannot still successfully connect my website to the plugin.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports inability to connect the website to the plugin, undermining the claim of direct posting to WordPress.

exhibits.quote: WPAutoBlog offers AI article generation at scale with direct publishing to your WordPress blog.
exhibits.argument: Review confirms AI article generation at scale with direct publishing to WordPress blog.

exhibits.quote: Connect your WordPress blog to automatically post your articles.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states WordPress blogs can automatically receive posted articles.

trials.claim: WPAutoBlog scales AI-generated articles to boost organic traffic with seamless WordPress publishing
trials.claimQuote: Introducing WPAutoBlog, your go-to solution for scaling AI-generated articles to boost organic traffic and integrate directly with your WordPress blog for seamless publishing.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report German articles mixing languages and being useless, and a failure to connect to custom post type categories, materially limiting the traffic-boosting and seamless publishing claims.

exhibits.quote: When WPAutoBlog generates articles in German, the output is a mix of German and English. So the articles are completely useless.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports generated articles were completely useless, undermining the claim they boost organic traffic.

exhibits.quote: I bought the full six codes with a lot of excitement to use wpautoblog, but after activating and connecting my website, I realised to my surprise that it does not connect to custom post type categories :(
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the tool does not connect as expected, undermining the claim of seamless WordPress publishing.

exhibits.quote: Automate content creation and publishing with a plan that scales with your business.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes automating content creation and publishing with scaling plans.

exhibits.quote: Impressive results, my organic traffic really grew and the articles rank well.
exhibits.argument: Customer confirms organic traffic grew and articles rank well.

trials.claim: WPAutoBlog is an AI-powered content creation and publishing platform built for WordPress
trials.claimQuote: WPAutoBlog is an AI-powered content creation and publishing platform built for WordPress.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report they could not connect a website to the WordPress plugin and that article usage stayed stuck for months, materially undercutting it as a working WordPress content creation and publishing platform.

exhibits.quote: Website won't connect to plugin. I've tried everything in your documentations page and I cannot still successfully connect my website to the plugin.
exhibits.argument: Buyer could not connect any website, undermining the claim it is a publishing platform built for WordPress.

exhibits.quote: It keeps saying 0/25 Articles Used from months. It has become useless.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the article generation stopped working for months, undermining the claim it is a content creation platform.

exhibits.quote: WPAutoBlog is an autoblogging tool that combines AI article generation, smart scheduling, and keyword research to automatically create and publish content on your WordPress blog.
exhibits.argument: Vendor defines WPAutoBlog as AI generation plus automated WordPress publishing.

exhibits.quote: WPAutoBlog combines AI content generation with automated scheduling and WordPress publishing to handle that process for you.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes AI content generation with automated WordPress publishing platform.
